short_description: Reminds you to take your pills on time and shows when you took the last one.
description:
## How to use

- In the app's settings, set up to four doses, each with a name, a time and an on/off switch, and how soon to remind you again.
- When a dose is due, a capsule shakes on the front display next to the dose's name, with START = TAKEN under it. Press **Start** once you have taken it.
- Until you press Start, the reminder comes back after the interval you set.

## What you see

- Between doses: the clock and the next dose, such as OMEGA 3 08:30.
- On the back display: the last dose taken and when, such as Last: VIT D 08:12.

The BUSY Bar runs one app at a time, so reminders come only while this app is open. Works offline.
changelog: First release: up to four doses, a repeat interval, the last dose taken on the back display.
